other_conditions: Must be 35 years old as of 1st January.
Annual family income must not exceed ₹10 lakh.
Course duration must be 2 years for postgraduate, 4 years for PhD, and 1 year 6 months for research programmes.
For postgraduate studies, must have passed the graduation final examination with at least 55% marks.
For PhD, must have passed the postgraduate examination with at least 50% marks.
Must independently choose the foreign educational institution for admission.
Must be applying for a postgraduate or higher‑level degree.
benefits_summary: Covers tuition fees of $40,000 per year plus a living allowance of $9,000 and a contingency allowance of $1,000, along with visa, insurance, and travel expenses.
documents_required: Hard copy of the prescribed application form
Copies of all mandatory documents (self‑attested if required)
